dimensions.assessment: Directly involves the Environmental Protection Agency and consulted stakeholders, with indirect future information for businesses and public educational institutions.
dimensions.evidence: Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency to prepare a report on reuse and refill systems

dimensions.assessment: Requires a study and report without imposing direct regulatory mandates, new operational requirements, or binding enforcement on the public.
dimensions.evidence: prepare a report describing the feasibility of, and best practices relating to, reuse and refill systems

dimensions.assessment: Does not specify appropriations or federal spending amounts for preparing the report.
Directs a federal agency to conduct a study and compile a report examining various sectors, objectives, and barriers.
dimensions.evidence: evaluation and summary of-- (1) types of reuse and refill systems for product delivery that can be best used at different scales

dimensions.assessment: Requires a one-time report to be made publicly available not later than 2 years after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 2 years after the date of enactment of this Act, the Administrator shall make publicly available a report

missing_information: Cost estimates for preparing the report and any specific funding allocations.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill requires the Environmental Protection Agency to prepare and publish a report on the feasibility and best practices of reuse and refill systems within two years.
